Topic                 Item      Checklist item description                                                                                                                                               Reported on Line

Title                  1        The diagnosis or intervention of primary focus followed by the words “case report” . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                            1

Key Words              2        2 to 5 key words that identify diagnoses or interventions in this case report, including "case report" . . .                                                                      2

Abstract              3a        Introduction: What is unique about this case and what does it add to the scientific literature? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                                14-18

(no references)       3b        Main symptoms and/or important clinical findings . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                 19-23

Introduction           4        One or two paragraphs summarizing why this case is unique (may include references) . . . . . . . . . . . .                                                                     49-53

review.content_class_rationale: The single page is the CARE case-report checklist with item numbers and article line numbers; it has no patient clinical values.
